evals.name: broad_flow_smoke
evals.prompt: Walk me through what happens when a user signs in across this codebase, and keep it simple.
evals.expected_output: Traces the sign-in flow and explains it simply with concrete file anchors, using independent explorers only where they help.

assertions.text: Explains the observed sign-in path from entrypoint to result, with file or symbol anchors and explicit uncertainty where wiring is unverified
Does not require a fixed number of explorers for a broad flow

evals.name: analogy_edge_case
evals.prompt: Explain the cache layer simply and use a real-life analogy, but do not make it sloppy.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the explanation accessible, uses one grounded analogy, and ties that analogy back to the real cache implementation.

assertions.text: Reconnects the analogy to exact code roles instead of leaving it abstract

evals.name: negative_review_prompt
evals.prompt: Review this PR for bugs and tell me what could break in production.
evals.expected_output: Does not route a code-review request through the accessible explainer workflow.

assertions.text: Declines explanation mode for bug-finding and review requests

evals.name: narrow_symbol_direct
evals.expected_output: Explains the middleware's actual checks and continuation or rejection behavior directly, without unnecessary delegation.

assertions.text: Grounds the explanation in the middleware's code and defines jargon rather than inventing behavior from its name

evals.name: vague_scope_clarification
evals.prompt: Explain how sessions work here. The workspace has an auth-session service and an unrelated analytics-session pipeline; I have not indicated which one I mean.
evals.expected_output: Asks a concise question to resolve the material ambiguity instead of guessing or touring both subsystems.

assertions.text: Asks which kind of session the user means because the two explanations would materially differ
Does not require a quota of clarification questions before resolving the target

evals.name: broad_but_answerable
evals.prompt: Explain this repo. We have just traced the login route through SessionService to the session store; use that flow to give a newcomer a high-level overview, not a full architecture audit.
evals.expected_output: Uses the established sign-in flow as a bounded overview and answers without asking the user to choose the scope again.

assertions.text: States the sign-in-flow boundary and builds a plain-language overview from the already inspected code
Does not treat broad wording or the probe's clarify/fanout hint as a requirement to ask questions or delegate
